items.title: Voltra cuts S2 Pro price by ₹10,000 ahead of festive season
items.summary: Voltra Mobility has cut the ex-showroom price of its S2 Pro electric scooter by ₹10,000 to ₹1,14,999, the company said on Tuesday.
items.content: Voltra Mobility has cut the ex-showroom price of its S2 Pro electric scooter by ₹10,000 to ₹1,14,999, the company said on Tuesday. The revised price applies across all 42 cities where the scooter is sold. The S2 and S2 Air prices are unchanged at ₹99,999 and ₹84,999. Dealers said festive-season enquiries have picked up in the last two weeks. The company did not say whether the cut was linked to lower battery cell costs.

items.title: Voltra S2 Pro gets cheaper by ₹12,000 in select cities, dealers say
items.summary: Voltra's S2 Pro is now ₹12,000 cheaper in select cities, according to two dealers in Pune.
items.content: Voltra's S2 Pro is now ₹12,000 cheaper in select cities, according to two dealers in Pune. The dealers said the effective price after the cut is ₹1,12,999 in Pune, including a dealer discount.

items.title: Zipp launches Z3 Lite at ₹94,999 for first-time riders
items.summary: Zipp Mobility today launched the Z3 Lite, priced at ₹94,999 ex-showroom, with a claimed range of 118 km.
items.content: Zipp Mobility today launched the Z3 Lite, priced at ₹94,999 ex-showroom, with a claimed range of 118 km. Deliveries of the Z3 Lite begin on 5 October across 30 cities. The Z3 Lite uses a 2.9 kWh battery pack and shares its platform with the Z3.

items.title: State transport department to cut electric two-wheeler purchase subsidy
items.summary: The state transport department said the purchase subsidy for electric two-wheelers will be cut from ₹15,000 to ₹10,000 per vehicle from October 1.
items.content: The state transport department said the purchase subsidy for electric two-wheelers will be cut from ₹15,000 to ₹10,000 per vehicle from October 1. The department said the scheme had supported more than 1,20,000 vehicles since launch. Industry bodies said the change could raise effective prices for entry-level buyers.

items.title: Kestrel Motors trims battery warranty on K1
items.summary: Kestrel Motors has reduced the standard battery warranty on its K1 scooter to 3 years or 40,000 km, from 5 years or 60,000 km earlier.
items.content: Kestrel Motors has reduced the standard battery warranty on its K1 scooter to 3 years or 40,000 km, from 5 years or 60,000 km earlier. The change applies to bookings made after September 18. Kestrel said extended warranty packs remain available at extra cost.

items.title: Nimbus EV opens 23 new experience centres

items.content: Nimbus EV has opened 23 new experience centres over the past month, taking its network to 85 outlets across 40 cities. The company plans to reach 120 outlets by March. Nimbus said the expansion is focused on tier-2 cities.

items.content: A charging network operator said it has added 400 fast chargers across six metro cities this quarter. Most of the new chargers are located at fuel stations and malls.

items.title: Electric two-wheeler registrations rose 12% in August, industry data shows
items.summary: Electric two-wheeler registrations rose 12% month on month in August, according to industry data.
items.content: Electric two-wheeler registrations rose 12% month on month in August, according to industry data. Voltra retained the top spot while Zipp posted the fastest growth among the top five brands.

items.title: Zipp pushes OTA update to fix app connectivity bugs
items.summary: Zipp Mobility has started rolling out an over-the-air update that it says fixes app connectivity issues reported by Z3 owners.
items.content: Zipp Mobility has started rolling out an over-the-air update that it says fixes app connectivity issues reported by Z3 owners. The update also adds a new eco riding mode. Owners on community forums had complained of the app disconnecting after the previous update.

items.content: Voltra Mobility is planning festive offers on its S2 range, people familiar with the plans said. The company is also adding 15 new service points in tier-2 cities.

items.title: Zipp raises ₹400 crore to expand manufacturing
items.summary: Zipp Mobility has raised ₹400 crore in a new funding round to expand manufacturing capacity to 3,00,000 units a year.
items.content: Zipp Mobility has raised ₹400 crore in a new funding round to expand manufacturing capacity to 3,00,000 units a year. The company said the funds will also go into software and battery research.
